mapper.select: SELECT s.id as survey_id, s.title as survey_title, q.id as question_id, q.question_title, q.question_type, COALESCE(a.total_responses, 0) as total_responses FROM wjdc_survey s LEFT JOIN wjdc_survey_question q ON s.id = q.survey_id LEFT JOIN ( -- 预先聚合答案数据 SELECT question_id, COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) as total_responses FROM wjdc_survey_answer WHERE question_id IN ( SELECT id FROM wjdc_survey_question WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId} ) GROUP BY question_id ) a ON q.id = a.question_id WHERE s.id = #{surveyId} ORDER BY q.sort_order;

select q.id as question_id, q.question_title, q.question_type, o.id as option_id, o.option_text, count(case when a.answer_text like concat('%,', o.id, ',%') or a.answer_text like concat(o.id, ',%') or a.answer_text like concat('%,', o.id) or a.answer_text = o.id then 1 end) as select_count, concat(round(count(case when a.answer_text like concat('%,', o.id, ',%') or a.answer_text like concat(o.id, ',%') or a.answer_text like concat('%,', o.id) or a.answer_text = o.id then 1 end) * 100.0 / (select count(distinct a2.response_id) from wjdc_survey_answer a2 where a2.question_id = #{questionId}), 2), '%') as select_percentage from wjdc_survey_question q left join wjdc_survey_option o on q.id = o.question_id left join wjdc_survey_answer a on q.id = a.question_id where q.id = #{questionId} group by q.id, q.question_title, q.question_type, o.id, o.option_text order by o.sort_order

select q.id as question_id, q.question_title, q.question_type, a.answer_text, count(*) as answer_count from wjdc_survey_question q left join wjdc_survey_answer a on q.id = a.question_id where q.id = #{questionId} and (q.question_type = '3' or q.question_type = '4') and a.answer_text is not null and a.answer_text != '' group by q.id, q.question_title, q.question_type, a.answer_text order by answer_count desc limit 20

SELECT q.id AS question_id, q.question_title, q.question_type, o.id AS option_id, o.option_text, AVG(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.answer_text, CONCAT('$."', o.id, '"'))) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS average_score, STDDEV_POP(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.answer_text, CONCAT('$."', o.id, '"'))) AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS standard_deviation FROM wjdc_survey_question q LEFT JOIN wjdc_survey_option o ON q.id = o.question_id LEFT JOIN wjdc_survey_answer a ON q.id = a.question_id AND JSON_EXTRACT(a.answer_text, CONCAT('$."', o.id, '"')) IS NOT NULL WHERE q.id = #{questionId} GROUP BY q.id, q.question_title, q.question_type, o.id, o.option_text ORDER BY o.sort_order

select s.id as survey_id, s.title as survey_title, count(r.response_id) as total_responses from wjdc_survey s left join wjdc_survey_response r on s.id = r.survey_id group by s.id, s.title order by total_responses desc

select s.id as survey_id, s.title as survey_title, q.id as question_id, q.question_title, q.question_type, count(distinct a.response_id) as total_responses from wjdc_survey s left join wjdc_survey_question q on s.id = q.survey_id left join wjdc_survey_answer a on q.id = a.question_id where s.id = #{surveyId} group by s.id, s.title, q.id, q.question_title, q.question_type order by q.sort_order
